english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for insurance coverage; in a metaphorical context it can also mean a precaution or safeguard, while 保單 is more precise for the policy document.

examples.english: I bought insurance, so I feel more at ease when travelling.
examples.traditional: 我買咗保險，去旅行安心啲。
